# Brand files — a frozen snapshot, not the master

These 14 files are the RELCO Wheels logo kit **as it stood on 31 October 2026**, copied into the
project so that the site's own folder is self-contained and can be handed to someone else without
them having to find a directory in `~/Documents`.

**The master copy lives in `~/Documents/apps/ASSETS/logos/relco-wheels/`** and is regenerated by the
`logo-system` skill. These are a copy of it and must never be edited here.

Editing them would create a second source of truth for a brand asset, and the two would drift
silently — the folder would keep the old mark the day after the mark changes, and nothing would say
so. If a logo needs to change, change it with the skill and re-copy.

## What is in here

The family mark is constant across every RELCO property — the R glyph in ink `#0C1014`, the orange
node `#C9541F` as a circle of radius 4.6, byte-identical between properties. Only the tile colour
differs per property, and the node colour is a constant in code rather than a per-property setting.

RELCO Wheels takes the blue tile `#1B4AD4`, which no sibling property uses. The occupied hexes
across the portfolio are recorded in `docs/plans/per-property-design-identity.md`.
